self.beaker.name: laboratory beaker
self.beaker.description: Locally imported/derived laboratory beaker; functional bottom ID 3. Follow exact point semantics. Candidate side grasps require robot verification.

functional_points.description: Upper opening centre; local +Z points out of the vessel.
functional_points.usage: Receiving/pouring mouth alignment. Never use this point to place the bottom on a table.

functional_points.description: Interior floor centre, inside the hollow receiving volume.
functional_points.usage: Define the receiving region for dry pellets. It is not the external support plane.

functional_points.description: Selected rim surface point stored in the local mesh frame.
functional_points.usage: Candidate pouring-edge alignment. It is not a calibrated spout or guaranteed pouring direction.

functional_points.description: External lower support-plane centre, with local -Z outward.
functional_points.usage: Use this functional point for upright support placement. Do not substitute the opening or inner floor.

contact_points.description: Side grasp centre, candidate 0; contact-frame +Y points toward object-frame +X.
contact_points.usage: Candidate grasp frame; pregrasp offset is along contact +Y and approach along -Y. Must pass this robot's actual grasp/clearance validation.

contact_points.description: Side grasp centre, candidate 1; contact-frame +Y points toward object-frame +Y.
contact_points.usage: Candidate grasp frame; pregrasp offset is along contact +Y and approach along -Y. Must pass this robot's actual grasp/clearance validation.

contact_points.description: Side grasp centre, candidate 2; contact-frame +Y points toward object-frame -X.
contact_points.usage: Candidate grasp frame; pregrasp offset is along contact +Y and approach along -Y. Must pass this robot's actual grasp/clearance validation.

contact_points.description: Side grasp centre, candidate 3; contact-frame +Y points toward object-frame -Y.
contact_points.usage: Candidate grasp frame; pregrasp offset is along contact +Y and approach along -Y. Must pass this robot's actual grasp/clearance validation.
